_why: Per-page exceptions to the transform. Data, not code, so a QA fix is an edit here plus a re-run. Every `rewrites` entry MUST match at least once or the build fails: they encode assumptions about the source prose, and a silent no-op would ship the old wording.
_strip_why: The sources copy-paste their chrome inline into every page, hardcoding background:#fff and linking to the old domain. The chassis supplies header, footer and head at assembly, so all of it must come out or every page would carry two headers.
_forbidden_why: A surviving link to a page we did not port would be a live 404. Fail the build instead.
_link_map_why: Applied after the generic relative-path resolution, for links the URL map cannot infer.

websitedesign.com/tools/vibe-equalizer/i._why: Its .tool-nav is chrome EXCEPT for #btn-share, which is the tool's own Share control. Rescue the button before the strip takes the bar with it.
